decisive_items: Nodular growth observed on the mid third of the tongue
Neoplastic cells immunoreactive for calretinin, confirming mesothelial origin
Neoplastic subepithelial proliferation, consisting of epithelioid cells in the tongue
response.rationale: R4 directly addresses the new tongue lesion, which was pathologically confirmed as mesothelial in origin and therefore represents metastasis of the known malignant pleural mesothelioma. R2 only captures the primary pleural disease and does not account for the current tongue nodule.

rejected.why: Describes primary pleural disease but fails to account for the tongue nodule and its mesothelial differentiation, which defines the current presentation as metastatic mesothelioma.
